scientific_limitations: Only degree-four forms over F2 that vanish at all seven F2-points, with geometric smoothness required for the three F2-rational members of a pencil; geometric members over extensions can be singular. A published individual-curve matrix criterion is used and independently checked. Complete base intersection has three nonreduced geometric points of length three each. Prioritization against unindexed earlier computations is uncertain.
title: Eight smooth plane-filling quartic pencils over \(\mathbb F_2\) and their triple base points
